c2pa_conformance_trust_list.notes: C2PA conformance program trust list (claim-signing anchors). Ages; refresh with manage_realworld.py fetch --refresh-trust.

c2pa_conformance_tsa_trust_list.notes: C2PA conformance program timestamp-authority trust list (RFC 3161 TSA anchors). Ages; refresh with manage_realworld.py fetch --refresh-trust. Note: widely used public TSAs (e.g. DigiCert's public responder, used by IPTC's live production signer) are NOT on this list - a timeStamp.untrusted verdict against it is correct and matches the reference c2patool.

iptc_vnpl_end_entity_list.notes: IPTC Verified News Publishers List end-entity certificates (allow-list). The companion anchor list at https://trust.iptc.org was empty on the accessed date, which is legitimate. Ages; refresh with manage_realworld.py fetch --refresh-trust.

vectors.notes: IPTC's designated invalid-content negative: Truepic libc2pa signed with a certificate that chains to no conformance-list anchor. The invalidity is trust-scoped - the signature itself verifies, so validation_state stays Valid while signingCredential.untrusted is present; the exact-failure-set assertion is what makes this a negative vector. Reference c2patool run at 2026-08-05 wall-clock additionally reports signingCredential.expired (cert window 2024-04-30..2025-04-30 had lapsed) and state Invalid - time-context difference; at the pinned time inside the window its remaining verdicts agree (untrusted, signature validates).

vectors.notes: LIVE production content from iptc.org/news (not the sample tree): full-size article image signed by 'IPTC Signer for C2PA' 2.0.1 (c2pa-rs 0.78.7), the conformant WordPress plugin, claim certificate issued by Trufo Inc. chaining to the C2PA conformance trust list - the only vector in this lane reaching signingCredential.trusted/state Trusted against the real conformance stack. Assertion set is the IPTC guide's recommended shape (c2pa.ingredient.v3, cawg.metadata, cawg.training-mining, c2pa.actions.v2, c2pa.hash.data) but still carries NO cawg.identity: even IPTC's current production signer does not yet deploy the two-signature architecture. The 300x143 WordPress rendition of the same upload is also signed (sign-every-rendition practiced). RFC 3161 timestamp present; timeStamp.untrusted informational is CORRECT even against the pinned C2PA conformance TSA trust list: the asset's timestamp comes from DigiCert's public responder (DigiCert SHA256 RSA4096 Timestamp Responder 2025 1), which is not a conformance-program TSA; the reference c2patool reports the same trust verdict. Known verifier granularity gap recorded: c2patool additionally emits timeStamp.validated (digest integrity) alongside untrusted, and the older sigTst (v1) headers on the legacy IPTC samples are not yet parsed by this verifier - both tracked as follow-ups.
